sermons.title: Sermon 3493 | Daily Blessings for God's People

scripture.verse: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. He that is our God is the God of salvation, and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

And all the trees of the field shall know that I, Jehovah, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish. I, Jehovah, have spoken and have done it."
Thou shalt be dumb and not able to speak until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
But now in Christ Jesus, ye, who sometimes were far off, are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

And behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the Lord, but the Lord was not in the earthquake: and after the earthquake a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice. And it was so. when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

sermons.title: Sermon 3499 | The Bliss of the Glorified

scripture.verse: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more, neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

sermons.title: Sermon 3500 | Two Coverings and Two Consequences

scripture.verse: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper. Proverbs 38:13 Thou Hast covered all their sins.

sermons.title: Sermon 3501 | The Feast of the Lord

scripture.verse: For as often as ye eat this bread and drink this cup, ye do show the Lord's death till he come.
